mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: App details (by package name or URL)
mode.description: What to fetch. Detail returns the full app record; search, developer and chart return ranked lists (add 'Full details' to enrich every list entry).

appIds.title: App IDs or Play Store URLs
appIds.description: Used in detail mode. Android package names (com.spotify.music) or store URLs (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music).

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Used in search mode. One Play Store search per term, up to 'Maximum results' apps each.

developerIds.title: Developers
developerIds.description: Used in developer mode. The developer name exactly as shown on Play (Spotify AB) or the numeric developer id from a developer URL (id=5700313618786177705).

chartCategory.title: Chart category
chartCategory.description: Used in chart mode. APPLICATION and GAME are the overall charts; the others are category charts.

country.title: Country (store)
country.description: Two-letter store country: us, gb, de, in, br, jp ... Prices, availability and charts depend on it.

language.title: Language
language.description: Store language for titles and descriptions (en, es, de, pt-br ...). The data-safety summary is parsed from English pages, so keep en if you need it.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Per search term, per developer, or for the chart (up to 500). In detail mode it caps the number of app IDs processed.

fullDetail.title: Full details for list results
fullDetail.description: In search, developer and chart modes, fetch the full app record for every list entry (installs, histogram, version, IAP, data safety). Each enriched app is charged as an app-detail event and takes about one second.

includeDataSafety.title: Include data-safety summary
includeDataSafety.description: Adds the Data safety card of each detailed app (shared and collected data types, encryption in transit, deletion request) parsed from the same page load. No extra request or charge.
